profile.headline: Quant Dev @ Commodities House
profile.summary:
Hi I'm Benjamin Nguyen and I love projects that require an understanding of the top-down model while also requiring attention to the nitty, gritty details. I am CTO of Quant where I focus on two parts: delivering the software infrastructure required by our researchers, and creating an Exchange that provides level 3 market data for our competitions.

As one of the top executives of Quant, my missions is to help our students break into the field of HFT Quant Trading, and I do this by reading up on the field and presenting relevant projects to our students that allow them to develop skills to put on their resume. My second mission is to introduce more people into the world of Quant Finance and HFT trading, especially supporting underrepresented minorities. Our networks with the top HFT and Quant firms means we are able to offer our students one of the best exposures into this field they can get at the University level, while connecting them with future employers who prefer students well-versed in the area. 

In my free time, I love learning more about random facts with whatever programming language I'm working in, learning about the economics of the world, and also min-maxing my characters in games. I also love playing the piano and swimming which I do to take my mind off things.

positions.description:
- Explain assignments and support students in weekly lab sessions
- Hold 10+ hrs/week Office Hours to help answer questions in a live-support manner
- Deliver course content through videos/articles on website. 
- Clarify questions on C++ nuances, such as pointers, references, namespaces, etc.
positions.insights: Debugging Code, University Teaching and +2 skills

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant (UIUC CS REU)
positions.description:
- Read 2 research papers weekly on cutting edge of Motion Planning (HATEB, PRM's, RL, etc.)
- Incorporate RTabMap ROS into the Boxer navigation stack for Visual SLAM
- Improve Ubuntu support for Parasol Planning Library, allowing users to install without problems
- Code OBPRM as one of the supported Motion Planning Strategies for open sourcing PPL
- Brainstorm research surrounding Dynamic Obstacle Navigation and World Belief

honors.title: California State Seal of Biliteracy
honors.description:
(a) The State Seal of Biliteracy certifies attainment of a high level of proficiency by a graduating high school pupil in one or more languages, in addition to English, and certifies that the graduate meets all of the following criteria:

(1) Completion of all English language arts requirements for graduation with an overall grade point average of 2.0 or above in those classes.

(2) Passing the California Assessment of Student Performance and Progress for English language arts, or any successor test, administered in grade 11, at or above the “standard met” achievement level, or at the achievement level determined by the Superintendent for any successor test.

(3) Proficiency in one or more languages other than English, demonstrated through one of the following methods:

(A) Passing a world language Advanced Placement examination with a score of 3 or higher or an International Baccalaureate examination with a score of 4 or higher.

(B) Successful completion of a four-year high school course of study in a world language, attaining an overall grade point average of 3.0 or above in that course of study, and oral proficiency in the language comparable to that required pursuant to subparagraph (A).

...
